import json
import os
import time


def main():
    params = json.loads(os.environ.get("CAP_PARAMS", "{}"))
    end = time.time() + 400
    while time.time() < end:
        time.sleep(1)
    print(json.dumps([{"metric": "PERF_SB_TIMEOUT", "value": 1.0, "unit": "%"}]))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
